hello-solid.title: Hello Solid
hello-solid.excerpt: Getting started with Solid and TanStack Router.
hello-solid.body: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Combined with TanStack Router, you get type-safe, loader-driven routing out of the box.

loaders-explained.title: Loaders Explained
loaders-explained.excerpt: How loader-driven data fetching works in TanStack Router.
loaders-explained.body: TanStack Router runs loaders when navigation starts and caches the result per params. The component then renders with data already in hand — no in-component fetching required.

prerendering.title: Prerendering
prerendering.excerpt: Serving static HTML for every route at build time.
prerendering.body: With prerendering, every route is rendered to static HTML at build time. This gives you fast first paint and great SEO while keeping the full SPA experience.
